title: Latency Shield: optimizer gatekeeper and dynamic rollback
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Automated batching/caching recommendations materially reduce per-token cost but occasionally increase tail latency for specific routes or customer cohorts. We need a platform-level guard that can safely apply optimizer recommendations and automatically rollback or circuit-break when SLOs are threatened.

Goal: Build an "optimizer gatekeeper" that 1) computes conservative per-route batching/caching change proposals, 2) stages them (shadow/apply cohorts), 3) monitors latency and throughput signals with anomaly detection, and 4) executes automated rollback or traffic routing adjustments when SLO guardrails trip. This work ties together the recommendation engine, the config apply service, routing policies, and observability (traces/metrics).
acceptance_criteria: Gatekeeper evaluates and produces per-route apply plans with conservative thresholds and an estimated cost delta (tokens/sec and $/token).
Staged apply path: allow shadow/observe, canary (1%->10%->50%), full apply, and automated rollback on rule triggers.
Anomaly detector flags latency distribution shifts (p95 and p99) and throughput regressions with false-positive suppression (statistical bootstrapping + rate hysteresis).
SLO-aware routing policy can divert traffic to fallback model/region/cohort automatically when guards trip.
Runbook and an automated incident message template (Slack + incident dashboard link) are generated on rollback with root-cause probs attached.
Integration tests (integration suite) that simulate a 2x latency regression on canary cohort and verify rollback within configured window (<= 5 minutes).
Performance: gatekeeper decision latency < 1s for incoming plan evaluation so long-running applies are not delayed in the control plane.
tasks: Design guardrail schema: soft/hard thresholds, soft-degrade actions, and metadata for grouping routes/cohorts.
Extend recommendation engine to emit 'safety profile' (expected p95 delta, confidence).
Implement staged apply orchestration with shadow, canary progression, and finalization APIs in config-service.
Build anomaly detection pipeline: bootstrap baseline distributions, detect drift using ADWIN and bootstrap CI, and backoff logic to avoid noisy rollbacks.
Add routing hooks for immediate fallback to compatible model variant or region when hard guard trips.
Create observability dashboards and SLO playbooks; add automated alerting and rollback notifications to Slack channel #inference-ops.
E2E tests and chaos scenarios to validate rollback timing and no-regression on normal traffic.
Docs: Confluence runbook, API docs for gatekeeper, and SDK examples for customers to opt-out or pin config.
comments: 2025-11-13 - Kickoff: scoped artifact. Agreed to keep apply decisions idempotent and to avoid per-request control plane calls (cache decisions locally in route-agent).

2025-11-18 - Spike: implemented a prototype that simulates a 25% batching increase for a high QPS route. Measured p95 increase ~120ms in lab. Saved 18% token cost. Prototype used shadow traffic via routing rule. - Mateo

2025-11-24 - Architecture review notes: Design suggested two-tier thresholds (soft action: reduce batching incrementally; hard action: immediate rollback + route diversion). PM asked to add explicit 'customer opt-out' flag in plan. - Claire Zhang (PRD review)

2025-11-28 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/config-service/pulls/4985. Adds canary progression state machine and rollback API. Need security review for new KMS writes during staged apply. - Mateo

2025-11-30 - Observability: dashboard draft at grafana.redwoodinfra.com/d/opt-guard/optimizer-gatekeeper. Added p50/p95/p99, queue-depth, batch-size, token-rate panels. Alert rule: p99 > baseline + 30% for 3m triggers soft alert; hard alert if duration > 5m or error spike > 2x. - SRE

2025-12-02 - Integration test failing intermittently: simulated canary rollback not invoking route diversion due to race in cohort-state update. Root cause identified in state transition ordering; PR coming to fix. - Mateo
2025-12-03 - Decision: force immediate timeline for rollback fix and add stronger contract tests. Security review scheduled 2025-12-05. Plan to roll to alpha customers in next cycle. - Aisha
